name: Chizuko Ueno
shortBio: Leading Japanese feminist sociologist who fused Marxist feminism with post-structuralist critique to analyze patriarchy and capitalism as dual systems governing unpaid reproductive labor, family ideology, and care.
centralQuestion: How do capitalism and patriarchy collaborate to extract unpaid domestic and elder-care labor inside the modern nuclear family?

keyWorks.title: Patriarchy and Capitalism (Kafuchosei to Shihonsei)
keyWorks.description: Foundational Japanese Marxist-feminist treatise demonstrating the structural interdependence of capitalist markets and domestic patriarchy.

keyWorks.title: Nationalism and Gender (Nashonarizumu to Jenda)
keyWorks.description: Deconstructs wartime state mobilization, historical memory, and gendered citizenship in modern Japan.
